page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource contention.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This memory density makes the server highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory density offer a robust platform for enterprise applications without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is designed for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance and large memory footprints, such as high-performance databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and large-scale data processing.
